claims.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle of A0.
claims.evidence: Fix the sheet orientations and minimize the sum of all x- and y-coordinates over the compact feasible configuration space. At a minimizer, every sheet not on the left boundary has a left blocker, and every sheet not on the top boundary has a top blocker; otherwise it could be translated slightly and decrease the objective. Following blockers strictly decreases the relevant coordinate and therefore ends at the boundary. Hence every right edge and bottom edge is a nonnegative sum of 52 and 37. Exact enumeration gives largest representable values at most 1189 and 841 equal to 1188 and 839, respectively; 1189, 840, and 841 are not representable. Thus a same-cardinality packing exists inside 1188×839.
claims.witness: Simultaneous stable representative; extremal sums 1188=20·52+4·37 and 839=14·52+3·37.
claims.search_method: Independent compactness/stabilization proof followed by exhaustive enumeration of all nonnegative 52i+37j within each container dimension.

claims.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
claims.evidence: The three coordinate families generate exactly 60, 8, and 448 distinct rectangles. Every rectangle has dimensions 52×37 or 37×52, lies inside 1188×839, and every one of the 132,870 unordered rectangle pairs is interior-disjoint. The exact checker regenerated the certificate and verified all these conditions.
claims.search_method: Exact generation, containment and dimension checks, followed by exhaustive pairwise integer-coordinate overlap testing.

claims.claim: No packing has 518 sheets; hence OPT≤517.
claims.evidence: After claim 0's normalization, use integer unit cells marked when x+y≡50 mod 52, each with weight 1/37. Every 52×37 rectangle has one marked cell in each of 37 rows, and every 37×52 rectangle has one in each of 37 columns, so every sheet has weight exactly 1. Exhaustive exact prefix-sum checking covered all 1,820,787 placements of both orientations and found weight numerator 37 for every placement. The container has exactly 19,162 marked cells, so its total weight is 19,162/37=517+33/37<518. Nonoverlap therefore forces an integral packing cardinality at most 517.
claims.witness: Residue-class weight certificate w(x,y)=1/37 when x+y≡50 (mod 52), and 0 otherwise, on the 1188×839 unit grid.
claims.search_method: Exact integer prefix sums; exhaustive evaluation of every placement in both orientations and exact total-weight comparison by integer cross-multiplication.

claims.claim: Any hypothetical 517-packing must span a maximum reduced dimension and contain a prescribed blocking chain.
claims.evidence: For a simultaneous left/top-stable normalized representative, occupied width and height are integers bounded by 1188 and 839. The sheet area is 517·52·37=994,708, while 1187·838=994,706. Thus the occupied bounding box cannot have both dimensions below their reduced maxima, so it reaches x=1188 or y=839. Stability supplies a blocker chain from that extreme edge to the corresponding origin boundary. Exact Diophantine enumeration shows the only width composition is 1188=20·52+4·37, and the only height composition is 839=3·37+14·52. This is only a necessary condition and does not exclude 517.
claims.witness: Area gap 994708−994706=2; unique chain compositions (20,4) for widths (52,37) and (3,14) for heights (37,52).
claims.search_method: Exact area comparison, simultaneous-stability blocker-chain argument, and exhaustive nonnegative Diophantine enumeration.

claims.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
claims.evidence: Area gives at most 68 sheets in 1188×111, and the stated 60+8 construction attains 68. For a bottom-band packing of N sheets, with n having orientation 52×37, exhaustive one-dimensional pattern checks prove 5h+7v≤98 whenever 37h+52v≤728 and 7h+5v≤160 whenever 52h+37v≤1188. Integrating these inequalities across the band gives 259N+n≤98·1188=116424 and 260N−n≤160·728=116480. Adding yields 519N≤232904<519·449, hence N≤448. A 32×14 grid of 37×52 sheets attains 448, so the split optimum is exactly 68+448=516.
claims.witness: Top certificate of 68 sheets and bottom 32×14 grid of 448 sheets, together with cross-section weights (5,7) and (7,5).
claims.search_method: Exact area arithmetic, exhaustive enumeration of all feasible integer cross-section patterns, integrated counting inequalities, and exact attainment checks.

target_evidence: The exact target requires deciding whether the optimum is 516, 517, or 518. The draft rigorously supplies a 516-sheet placement and rules out 518, establishing only 516≤OPT≤517. Its blocking-chain lemma and exact cap for one prescribed horizontal decomposition do not rule out general 517-packings. Thus it makes material but incomplete progress. Because the draft labels its resolution PARTIAL and does not assert an exact optimum, that claimed resolution is ACCURATE rather than overstated or understated.
